items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So then Andy Kirk sent me a telegram to come join Twelve Clouds of Joy because Ben had gone.

ctx.x: So he finally -- but he finally left and went on back to Bennie Moten and about time they got back -- and Basie was the last one to leave. He went on back to Bennie Moten, too, you know. Bennie started getting some jobs. They went into a club called the Harlem Club in Kansas City.

So then after that, Andy needs a tenor player. So Basie said, "Well, I got the man for you." He said, "He just left my band." So then Andy Kirk sent me a telegram to come join Twelve Clouds of Joy because Ben had gone.
